messages.content: Swimming is my favorite weekend activity. I love doing a few easy laps at the local pool on Saturday mornings. It clears my head after a busy week.
I've been swimming every weekend lately. I like the gentle exercise and how relaxed I feel afterward. A session at the pool is usually the highlight of my week.
I'd love to keep swimming as my regular weekend exercise. If you're suggesting something for Saturday, an easy swim at the pool would be perfect.

The local pool has closed for repairs for the next few months, so a friend took me cycling by the river this morning. I absolutely loved the fresh air and exploring the riverside path. Cycling is my new favorite weekend activity now, and I'd love to go for another relaxed bike ride next Saturday.
